Ethan — great to hear, glad the demo landed. Attaching a starter charter and a two-slide decision lane summary to speed things up. I seeded the MAP with suggested owners and a tech gating checklist tailored to clinical-note ingestion (you can edit the doc).

Quick overview here:
- Deliverables (week-by-week):
  1) Week 0 (setup): model variant selection, access + test dataset ingest, baseline perf run
  2) Week 1 (core validation): latency/throughput under target loads, initial quality checks on held-out prompts
  3) Week 2 (integration): streaming + KV cache test, CI hooks to your staging app, cost-per-token monitoring
  4) Week 3 (stress & edge cases): long-context behavior, failure-mode tests, PII resiliency checks
  5) Week 4 (acceptance & exec prep): acceptance matrix signoff, executive summary + rollout recommendation

- Acceptance matrix (in doc): functional gates, perf thresholds (p99 latency, median latency), quality slices, and security checklist items we expect to be validated by your InfoSec.

Attachments (stubs):
- MAP_Charter_30d_v1.gdoc (seed): Google Doc — editable, includes owners + acceptance matrix
- Decision-Lane-and-Acceptance-Deck_v1.gslides (2 slides): summary for execs

Next steps: can you confirm the internal stakeholders who should be editors on the doc (PM/Eng/InfoSec) and any blackout dates for your execs? I can run a short kickoff with Marissa (CS) and Jasmine (solutions engineer) early next week.

—Olga
Olga Petrov
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
